summary: Human approves the reviewed invocation snapshot revision. LocalResponseGateway must create one top-level shallow invocation snapshot after local/ONNX guards and before registry freshness; the cache-key deriver and executor must receive that same snapshot. Nested or opaque leaf objects are not deep-copied and must not be mutated by the caller while generation is running. Documentation remains deferred to the post-merge 0.8.0 release phase. This clearance authorizes fresh RED tests and implementation, followed by aggregate reviews against the full PR range.
